note: Checked against vendor and Anthropic documentation in October 2026. Prefer Claude's connector directory. Entries with an empty url are matched to Claude's directory by name, the same way Anthropic's own plugins do it.

routes.one-click: In Claude's connector directory. Find it, click Connect, and sign in with your work login. Some need an admin's approval the first time.
routes.add-by-url: Not in the directory. Added by web address as a custom connector. On company Claude plans an Owner usually adds it.
routes.admin-project: Your IT or tool admin has to set it up first. Use the fallback until then.
routes.api-key: Needs a key from the tool, not just your login. Usually an admin request.
routes.none: No connector yet. Use the fallback.

connectors.name: Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive)
connectors.signin: Your Microsoft work or school account (personal outlook.com accounts do not work)
connectors.admin: A Global Admin grants tenant-wide consent once. On Claude Team and Enterprise an Owner also adds the connector. Write tools need a second consent.
connectors.readonly: Write tools are off by default; leave them off.
connectors.fallback: Claude in Chrome on Outlook and Teams on the web; save mail to PDF; download Teams transcripts into the drop folder.
connectors.notes: Claude's own connector, hosted by Anthropic. Covers Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, and OneDrive in one sign-in. Add it from Claude's connector directory; the plugin doesn't pre-list it because each company's Microsoft setup handles the sign-in.

connectors.name: Gmail
connectors.admin: On Claude Team and Enterprise an Owner enables it. A Google Workspace admin may need to mark Claude as trusted (the 'Access blocked' error).
connectors.readonly: Sending asks first by default; drafts stay with the user until they send them.
connectors.fallback: Claude in Chrome on Gmail; print a thread to PDF and drop it.
connectors.notes: Claude's own Gmail connector.

connectors.name: Google Calendar
connectors.admin: Same as Gmail.
connectors.readonly: The assistant proposes times by default; it doesn't create, accept, or decline events.
connectors.notes: Claude's own Google Calendar connector.

connectors.name: Google Drive (Docs, Sheets, Slides, Meet transcripts)
connectors.admin: Same as Gmail.
connectors.readonly: Upload, share, move, and trash ask first; the assistant reads only by default.
connectors.notes: Add Google Drive from Claude's connector directory.

connectors.name: Google Chat
connectors.signin: Sign-in through an app your company sets up in Google Cloud
connectors.admin: Google's developer preview plus an admin-created OAuth client.
connectors.fallback: Claude in Chrome on chat.google.com, or copy the thread.

connectors.name: Slack
connectors.admin: A Slack workspace admin approves the app once. Slack IP allowlists apply.
connectors.readonly: Set send and post tools to blocked or needs approval.
connectors.fallback: Claude in Chrome on Slack in the browser, or copy the thread.
connectors.notes: The plugin uses the same Slack sign-in Anthropic uses in its own plugins, because Slack doesn't let apps register themselves.

connectors.name: Zoom
connectors.admin: Paid Zoom plan; an owner or admin with privileges; AI Companion recording and summary turned on.
connectors.readonly: Keep write tools off.
connectors.fallback: Download the transcript or summary and drop it.
connectors.notes: Add Zoom from Claude's connector directory; the connector's web address is not published.

connectors.name: Webex Meetings
connectors.signin: Your Webex login, through a Webex integration
connectors.admin: Org admin enables it in Control Hub.
connectors.readonly: It can create and change meetings; keep writes off.

connectors.name: Fireflies
connectors.admin: None documented.
connectors.readonly: Read tools.
connectors.fallback: Download the transcript and drop it.

connectors.name: Otter
connectors.admin: Enterprise IT controls and audit log.
connectors.readonly: Read tools.
connectors.fallback: Export the transcript and drop it.

connectors.name: Granola
connectors.admin: Enterprise: off by default; admins set scopes and can block transcripts.
connectors.readonly: Read.

connectors.name: Fathom
connectors.admin: None documented.
connectors.readonly: Read-only.
connectors.fallback: Download the transcript and drop it.

connectors.name: tl;dv
connectors.admin: Pro plan or higher.
connectors.readonly: Read.
connectors.fallback: Download the transcript and drop it.

connectors.name: Atlassian (Jira, Confluence, Loom)
connectors.admin: An Atlassian site admin completes first consent. Domain and IP allowlists apply.
connectors.readonly: Ask the admin to turn on only the read and search permission groups.
connectors.fallback: A saved Jira filter emailed daily into the drop folder; Confluence page export to PDF or Word.
connectors.notes: Atlassian moves v1 connections to v2 automatically. Data Center (on-premises) sites cannot be reached by cloud connectors.

connectors.name: Trello
connectors.admin: Atlassian administration controls.
connectors.readonly: Pick workspaces and permissions at sign-in; no permanent delete.

connectors.name: Linear
connectors.admin: Optional enterprise sign-in rules.
connectors.readonly: There's a read-only version; the Claude Code setup uses it by default.

connectors.name: GitHub
connectors.signin: In Claude Code, a read-only personal access token, only if your company allows them
connectors.admin: Your GitHub organization's rules for apps and tokens apply.
connectors.readonly: The read-only version is used by default.
connectors.notes: If GitHub appears in your connector directory, use that. In Claude Code it works with a read-only token, if your company allows them.

connectors.name: GitLab
connectors.admin: A group owner or instance admin has to allow AI connections.
connectors.readonly: Your admin can limit which tools it offers.
connectors.notes: Beta. Many people behind one company network can hit the sign-in rate limit; an admin-created shared app fixes it.

connectors.name: Azure DevOps
connectors.admin: Claude Code needs an admin-registered Entra app; Claude Desktop is not supported.
connectors.readonly: There's a read-only setting.

connectors.name: Sentry

connectors.name: monday.com

connectors.name: ClickUp

connectors.name: Notion

commands.what: A skeptical second read before something goes to an exec.
A clean ticket or epic from messy notes. It drafts; you file it.
commands.without: Drafts from your notes today; filing it live needs a tracker.

commands.what: Any acronym, doc, or engineering note, explained like you're new.
Re-explain the last answer in plain words, like you got lost. No shame.
The short version of the last answer.
Poke holes in a plan before someone else does.
Five quiz questions from your own notes, with the source for each answer.
A 101 lesson on any topic, built from your own notes and tools, with a quiz.
Give a new project a home: status, decisions, sources, and a context map.
Log a decision with the why, so nobody relitigates it in a month.
File everything dropped in the inbox into the right project.
Find stale pages, broken links, and notes pretending to be current.
Merge duplicate follow-ups, fix fuzzy dates, and move finished projects to the archive. Never erases.
Connect another tool, or fix one that won't connect.
Change your answers: voice, partners, and what the agent is allowed to do.
